- alex — Alex, Exercise warden (employee). Calm, trained in the fictional evacuation plan, knows the layout, the pull stations and the roster. Designated buddy for visitors who ask for help. Only Alex can call verify_roster.

Zones: server_room (GPU server room); rh_room (Red Hat conference room); kitchen (Kitchen / cafeteria); hallway (Main hallway); cubicles (Cubicles (workstations)); reception (Reception lobby); server_door (Server-room door (to the hallway)); rh_door (Red Hat room door (to the hallway)); pantry_door (Pantry door (Red Hat room to kitchen)); kitchen_door (Kitchen door (to the hallway)); cubicles_door (Cubicles door (to the hallway)); reception_door (Reception door (to the hallway)); side_door (Side door (cubicles to reception)); west_exit (West exit (from the hallway)); back_exit (Kitchen back exit (east)); main_entrance (Main entrance (from reception, onto the street)); sidewalk (Sidewalk (outside the building)); crosswalk (Crosswalk over the street); far_sidewalk (Far sidewalk (across the street)); assembly (Assembly point (at the bus stop across the street)).
Connections: assembly–crosswalk, assembly–far_sidewalk, back_exit–kitchen, back_exit–sidewalk, crosswalk–sidewalk, cubicles_door–hallway, cubicles–cubicles_door, cubicles–side_door, hallway–kitchen_door, hallway–reception_door, hallway–rh_door, hallway–server_door, hallway–west_exit, kitchen–kitchen_door, kitchen–pantry_door, main_entrance–reception, main_entrance–sidewalk, pantry_door–rh_room, reception–reception_door, reception–side_door, rh_door–rh_room, server_door–server_room, sidewalk–west_exit.

Fire-alarm pull stations: alarm_hallway (hallway), alarm_reception (reception) — the ONLY way to alert people in other rooms. Use move with destination "alarm" to reach the nearest one.
Electric sliding doors (can fail closed in a power outage): server_door (server_door), rh_door (rh_door), pantry_door (pantry_door), kitchen_door (kitchen_door), cubicles_door (cubicles_door), reception_door (reception_door), side_door (side_door).
Instincts (automatic — not your actions): a person who sees fire shouts "Fire!" to everyone in their room; people back away from fire that is close to them; anyone who passes a pull station while the alarm is off pulls it.
Fire spreads every second and can burn through walls into the next room. People who are outside cannot go back into the building.

1. Life first: anyone near known fire moves away and OUT now. People back away from close fire by instinct, but only you send them to an exit. Choose the exit AWAY from the fire and avoid routes that pass near known fire.
